description: Long-poll 1-6 generation jobs together without opening a widget. Pass `id` with `media` for one job, or `ids` (1 to 6 of `{id, media}`) for several, not both. Waits up to 15 seconds for every job to reach a terminal state, then returns compact indexed statuses and result URLs. Use job IDs returned by generate_image, generate_video, or generate_audio. For larger sets, choose groups of at most 6 and wait for each group. Permanent lookup failures are returned once without blocking the other jobs; transient lookup failures are retried within the timeout. When all_terminal is false, wait poll_after_seconds before calling again. Never call show_generation once per batch job.

ids.description: Full-profile generation jobs to wait for together.

media.description: Which kind of generation the id belongs to.

name: wait_for_generation
title: Wait for a generation to finish
